name: Cobra Spit
body:
School conjuration (creation) [poison]; Level alchemist 2, druid 2, legendary ninja 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components S, M (a cobra’s fang)

EFFECT

Range 10 ft.

Area 10-ft. cone-shaped burst
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fort negates; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You spew forth a spray of virulent venom, causing all creatures in the area to take 1d3 points of Constitution damage. In addition, creatures failing their saves are dazzled for 1 minute by stinging in their eyes. Creatures rolling a natural 1 on their saving throw are instead blinded for 1 minute.
